notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where dialogue had a chance to cause an error after losing a fight with a fox.
Fixed a bug where the crown could not flip card after turning over the magnet.

Holographic Projection add Sturdy effect.
Kingship add CD (2) effect.
